description: This file configures a Spring Batch job for setting loan delinquency tags in the Fineract platform. It defines beans for a step, a job, and a tasklet used to classify or update the delinquency status of loans.

classes.name: SetLoanDelinquencyTagsConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that defines beans for the job, step, and tasklet responsible for setting loan delinquency tags.

methods.name: setLoanDelinquencyTagsStep
methods.description: Creates a Spring Batch Step that executes the tasklet for setting loan delinquency tags.

methods.name: setLoanDelinquencyTagsJob
methods.description: Creates a Spring Batch Job that runs the delinquency tagging step with an incrementer for job instance uniqueness.

methods.name: setLoanDelinquencyTagsTasklet
methods.description: Creates the tasklet object used within the step to perform the actual delinquency classification logic.
